name: DES16E2clk field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the Type Ia supernova DES16E2CLK, seen by Hubble.
label: des16e2clk-hubble
story: Hubble returned here again and again to follow a distant Type Ia supernova found by the Dark Energy Survey. Exploding stars like this one serve as cosmic yardsticks for tracing how the universe has expanded.

claims.text: DES16E2CLK is a target of RAISIN2, a Hubble program on Type Ia supernovae found by the Dark Energy Survey
Each new supernova got a sequence of repeated visits
Type Ia supernovae trace the cosmic expansion history
RAISIN2 followed spectroscopically classified supernovae from DES
